events.reason: A guard post right by my gate? I want that shiny coin!
No fights for me. I take the quiet post in the west and keep my coin.
I take the district at my doorstep and stay central for the next sweep.
Glory calls from the south post. I go get it.
Sabina! Race you to the middle - winner keeps the coin!
I keep away from that crowd and search the block beside me instead.
Revenge can wait. Two districts in two turns is the better trade.
Nerva hides a coin. I want it, so I cross the street and fight her.
Gaius has coins too! Race you across the plaza - fight me!
Those two can brawl. I slip south and open the block there.
C now, F next turn. The sweep stays on schedule.
Two coins is not enough. I hunt Nerva again for the title.
Rematch! You got lucky last time, my turn now!
Third piece means a sharper guard. I stay away from those two.
F first, then the two-step chain north. Three turns to full kit.
A pilum, and I stand one step from Nerva. Let her worry.
Fine, you all have armor. I want a shield too!
Away from all of them. The north block is quiet and has armor.
D as planned. Gaius can watch me take it.
Sabina shows off her full kit. I remind her I am still standing here.
Third time! Nobody beats me three times, Gaius!
I keep to the empty corner and take the sword there.
Last piece. Next stop, the junction in the middle.
Let her have her crown. My coins buy the next phase.
New opponent! Nerva, come out and play, I am coming over!
I want my sixth piece with my own hands, even if they hand it out later.
First Challenger. The junction is mine - the clock starts now.
A crown? I duel the champion herself. Glory loves the bold.
Gaius! You are 3 and 0 but today I break the streak!
My sixth piece, found by me. I trust no handouts.
Nothing left to win here. My gate sits on the Emperor door - I plan for that.
Coins burn a hole in my purse and there is no shop. One more duel, Rufus.
One last shiny before the horn blows. A helmet for me!
Level done. I head home and let the soldiers come to me.
I close the round at my own door. On to the Emperor.
At last, a market for my coins. Level 2, come fast.
A barracks full of guards? That is the best door on this street!
No coin leaves my purse. The cellar needs only a steady hand.
One coin buys a full turn of tempo. Worth it. Cellars next, then the Emperor.
Coins are for spending! One seal, bought and paid for!
The guards laughed at me. I knock on their door again, right now.
A guard is not a person, he is a door. I keep my coin and wrestle the door.
Cellars is the safest free roll on the board. Two seals, then I march south.
One more stamp and I can throw my last coin at the Emperor.
More dice! Cellars it is, I love the dark basement game.
I keep both coins. My own two hands are enough for one old man.
This is the turn that matters. Coin down, blade up.
Basement again. I need that last stamp before the big door.
Basement dice again! Third throw is the lucky one.
Coins stay in the purse. The Emperor falls to my hands alone.
No coin left to spend. Steel alone, then.
Third try in the basement. The Emperor door opens for me next.
CHARGE! No math, just run at the big man!
Spend nothing. My hoard is my safety, my arms are my chance.
A duel for coins costs me a turn I may not have. I swing now.
What is a coin for? Spending! Big swing, all of it!
Everyone in one room! I hit the Emperor first, watch me!
All three of them circle me. Still, the purse stays shut.
Empty purse, steady hand. This is the throw that decides it.
